en:
I feel excellent for the first time in a while!
My movements are on point, wouldn't you say!?
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Keebo for a while?

I see... You're interested in me because
I'm in top form today!

Very well, then!
I will show you my true personality!

<CLT=cltMIND>I couldn't tell if they were any different...
but I'll keep that to myself.
<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo and I grew a little closer today.
